name: K. Alger Woodworking & Custom Interiors Inc.
old_description: Specializing in custom cabinetry, millwork, woodworking, and installation for residential and commercial projects.
about:
K. Alger Woodworking & Custom Interiors Inc. operates as a specialty contractor in Johnston, Rhode Island. The company is led by owner Ken Alger, who heads a small shop dedicated to custom cabinetry and millwork.

The shop fabricates custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, crown molding, and custom woodworking for residential and commercial projects. Services include design, material takeoffs, fabrication, and installation. The company also provides cabinet refinishing and millwork design services. They work alongside cabinet shops from Maine to New York City.

Clients range from homeowners and designers to general contractors such as V&M Holding Co. The firm serves both residential remodel projects and commercial installations across the Northeast.

The company’s stated mission is “Building legacies through leadership, modern craftsmanship, and unexpected customer care.” Core values emphasize excellence, humility, respect, positive attitude, honesty, pride in performance, and giving more than received. Their philosophy stresses continuous learning from mistakes, respect for skilled design, and a positive team environment.
